title: When Approval Quietly Becomes Worship
headline: When Approval Becomes an Idol
tagline: Whatever you fear most, you will eventually obey most.
seo_title: When Approval Becomes an Idol: John 12:43 Devotional | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Whatever has the authority to override God's voice has become a functional lord. A devotional on John 12:43 about fear of man and misplaced worship.
verse_text: For they loved the glory that comes from man more than the glory that comes from God.

scriptures.text: For they loved the glory that comes from man more than the glory that comes from God.

blocks.text: Very few people wake up intending to worship approval.

items: It happens slowly.
Quietly.
Almost invisibly.
Worship isn’t first revealed by what we sing.
It’s revealed by what governs us.

blocks.text: What can make me disobey God?

items: If losing a promotion causes me to compromise….
If losing popularity causes me to stay silent….
If losing acceptance causes me to hide my convictions….
Then the issue isn’t merely fear.
It’s misplaced worship.

blocks.text: Whatever has the authority to override God’s voice has become a functional lord.

items: This is why Scripture repeatedly connects the fear of God with worship.
Fear isn’t merely trembling.
Biblically, fear is recognizing ultimate authority.
Whatever you fear most….
you will eventually obey most.
The religious leaders in Jesus’ day believed many true things.
Yet they loved human praise more than God’s approval.
That wasn’t simply a leadership failure.
It was a worship problem.
Every heart has a throne.
Something always occupies it.
The question isn’t whether we worship.
The question is who sits on the throne.
What am I most afraid of losing?
What criticism affects me more than God’s commands?
If everyone misunderstood my obedience, would I still obey?

blocks.text: Those questions often reveal who sits on the throne.

items: Father,
Reveal every place where I have exchanged Your approval for the applause of people.
Show me where fear has quietly become worship.
Teach me to fear You above every opinion and every crowd.
In Jesus name,
Amen.
